title: Immunization Record Standard — How Many Vaccination Courses a Patient Holds
content:
**Rule.** Under Immunization Services a patient may hold any number of vaccination courses, one per vaccine and, for seasonal vaccines, one per season. A second course of the same vaccination is opened only when no course of it is in scheduled or in progress status, and for a seasonal vaccine only when no course of it exists for the same season.

There is no maximum number of courses per patient; the only limits are the ones stated in the rule.

## Conditions for a second course of the same vaccination

| Situation on the patient's profile | Second course of that vaccination |
|---|---|
| A course of it is in scheduled status | Not opened |
| A course of it is in in progress status | Not opened |
| Seasonal vaccine: a course of it already exists for the same season, whatever its status | Not opened |

The table lists the situations the rule names; each of them is sufficient on its own to stop a second course.

## Hypothetical profiles

- A hypothetical patient holds a Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination course, a Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series course and a Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination course for the 2025-2026 season at the same time: one course per vaccine, which the rule permits.
- A hypothetical patient whose Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series course is in progress asks for another Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series course: none is opened while that course is in progress.
- A hypothetical patient already has a COVID-19 Updated Vaccination course for the 2025-2026 season that is completed: no second COVID-19 Updated Vaccination course is opened for the 2025-2026 season, because a course of it exists for that season.
